description: One transaction (two when paying in USDG: its approval first) from ETH or USDG to a ladder in a v4 pool of the token against the quote (ETH, USDG, LOOM, a stock, a memecoin with an exit). The pool is opened on LoomDesk's hook inside the same transaction when the pair has none (feePct 1 to 5, about a dollar); the sides the wallet's asset is not are bought through Nordstern inside it, split by the band; the pool's fee is paid from it; the ladder is built for the owner; leftovers come back. Prefer it over plan_swap + plan_open_pool + plan_ladder whenever the caller pays in ETH or USDG.

pool.description: A v4 pool of the token to build in, by id from ladder_pools: any pool, on the hook or not; the quote is then that pool's

quote.description: ETH, USDG, or the quote token's address
